title: Anthropic merges the memory systems for Claude chat and Claude Cowork, making Claude chat history available to Cowork unless users opt out (David Gewirtz/ZDNET)
summary: David Gewirtz / ZDNET: Anthropic merges the memory systems for Claude chat and Claude Cowork, making Claude chat history available to Cowork unless users opt out — ZDNET's key takeaways — Claude chat and Cowork now share one memory system. — Memory updates as you chat, with sensitive-data controls.
contentText:
David Gewirtz / ZDNET :

Anthropic merges the memory systems for Claude chat and Claude Cowork, making Claude chat history available to Cowork unless users opt out   —  ZDNET's key takeaways  — Claude chat and Cowork now share one memory system.  — Memory updates as you chat, with sensitive-data controls.
